title: ThemeConfig
description: Shape of the STORED themes.config JSONB column (ARCHITECTURE.md §2.1) — this is NOT the client-facing request schema. See config/theme_create_request.schema.json for what a POST /themes caller may actually submit; notably, that schema has no factor_weights field at all. factor_weights below is populated exclusively by the server from config/factor_weights.yaml at theme-creation time and is never accepted, read, or overridden from user/API input under any circumstance.

sub_exposures.description: 3-6 sub-exposure keys the Screener decomposes the theme into. Each MUST match a key in config/sub_exposure_etf_map.yaml for search_holdings() to resolve it (SCREENER_SKILL.md) — an unmapped sub-exposure is a known gap, not silently guessed.

factor_weights.description: SYSTEM-POPULATED ONLY. Copied verbatim from config/factor_weights.yaml by the POST /themes handler at theme-creation time — never present in, or accepted from, the client request body (see theme_create_request.schema.json). modeling_node reads this field directly and must never fall back to a code-level default (MODELING_SKILL.md Hard Rule 2). Keys must match the *_z factor names produced by compute_factor_scores.

screens.description: Hard liquidity/size screens applied by the Trader agent (ARCHITECTURE.md §5.4). Defaults match the Trader's system prompt; override per theme only with a stated reason.

min_avg_dollar_volume.description: USD. Candidates below this are flagged (not excluded) by the Screener; excluded by the Trader unless overridden.

max_per_sub_industry.description: Diversification cap — max basket positions from one GICS sub-industry.

weighting_scheme.description: ARCHITECTURE.md §5.4. If score_weighted, Trader normalizes composite scores to 100%, floors positions at 5%, caps at 20%.

validator_enabled.description: Whether the optional bull/bear Validator step (top ~12 names) runs for this theme — see ARCHITECTURE.md §11 open question on whether it's worth the added cost/latency.
